title: technological trajectories in iron smelting: slag signatures, recipes, and traditions from phnom dek (cambodia, 7th–20th c. ce)
core_idea: Investigate long-term technological change in iron production at Phnom Dek by analysing slag signatures, reconstructing smelting recipes, and examining continuity and transmission of metallurgical traditions.
tldr: Study aims to trace how iron-smelting techniques and recipes evolved and were transmitted at Phnom Dek through chemical and material analysis of slags and production evidence.
